name: Typeset
tagline: A well-set column: ink, grey, hairlines, and one terracotta mark where the work is.
mood: Calm and legible, like a magazine page you can read at a glance without being asked to look.
rationale: A tool glanced at a hundred times a day earns attention by being quiet and exact: words in ink or grey, colour on glyphs only, and the one terracotta mark reserved for where Claude is right now, so the eye lands there without searching. The spacing complaint is answered by a stated grid rather than decoration: a fixed glyph column, a fixed label column, a right column flush at one edge across every row, hairline rules under tracked small-cap labels, and exactly one blank line between sections so nothing touches its neighbour. Character comes from proportion and the hairline, not from ornament or motion, which is why it does not disturb.
tokenMap: The hexes above exist only so the page can render the mock; the implementation uses theme keys everywhere, which is the light-terminal answer (no hex in view.tsx). Three grey tiers, stated once: structure, labels, meta. bg: the terminal's own background, never painted. fg: `text` (ink), every word that is current or actionable. dim: two keys. Section labels (`N E E D S  Y O U`, `P L A N`, `S I G N A L S`, the `gate`/`git`/`context` label column) are `inactive` + bold, a theme grey with guaranteed contrast on light terminals and weak-dim palettes; plain `dimColor` is reserved for meta and the past: right-column values (sha, age, agent, count, cost), done steps (glyph and title), the branch, the chip strip's done/todo chips. accent: `claude` (terracotta, approximate hex), one lineage only: the health glyph when the run is working (▶), the current phase glyph ▶ and its chip ▶B, the doing step glyph ●, and in the band (which has no step glyph) the step title. accent2: `subtle`, the structure tone, used for every hairline AND every empty meter cell, so the meter reads as a rule being inked in; it is a grey, never a second hue. bg2: `subtle` as the hover background on pressable rows (keyed Boxes on terminal and desktop only); nothing else is ever painted. success: `success` on the gate ✓ and the finished-run health ✓ only; the meter is NOT green because progress is a fact, not a verdict. warning: `warning` on ? ~ § glyphs only. error: `error` on ! ✗ glyphs only. Words are never coloured except the band step title.

otherTabs: Plan: every phase is a ruled group whose label line reads `▶ ▾ B UI ┈┈┈ 2/6` (phase glyph in its tone, then the fold mark ▾/▸ the phase Button carries today, then key and title, hairline, count flush right); folded phases are one such line with ▸; the only terracotta is the current phase and its doing step; on desktop and mobile the phase row is the label alone with marginTop 1, exactly as rules are. Log: a label column of width 6 for the time in dimColor, text in ink, Rulings marked with a `§` glyph in warning at the glyph column (colour on the glyph, never the sentence). Step details: field labels in `inactive` at width 10 exactly like SIGNALS, values in ink, gate runs and commits right-aligned at col 71, the title line carrying the step's own glyph in its tone. Needs you: each question bold in ink under the same hairline rule, meta (asked 16:05 · blocks B4) in dimColor beneath, `why` as a width-10 label, options as `[ per seat ]` Buttons with the recommended one `primary`, answered items in dimColor with `✓` at the glyph column.
glyphs: Steps: todo `○` dimColor · doing `●` claude bold · done `✓` dimColor · blocked `!` error bold · skipped `–` dimColor. Current phase `▶` claude bold (chips: `✓A` dimColor, `▶B` claude, `○C` dimColor). Decision `?` warning bold · blocker `!` error bold · drift `~` warning · Ruling `§` warning (Log). Health (masthead and band): `▶` claude while working, so the masthead's one terracotta mark and the plan's ▶ point at the same thing · `!` error needs you · `✗` error gate red · `✓` success finished; `success` otherwise appears only on the gate ✓. Meter: filled `━` bold ink, empty `┈` in `subtle`; the same `┈` in the same tone is the hairline, so the meter reads as a rule being inked in. Section labels are tracked capitals (`P L A N`) in `inactive` bold, collapsing to untracked `PLAN` / `NEEDS YOU` / `SIGNALS` (same tone) when the column holding them is narrower than 48 content cells, hairline kept. Finished state: health `✓` success, meter all `━`, elapsed reads `took 2h05m`, every chip `✓` dimColor, PLAN shows the last phase folded. Empty states: nothing asked → the label reads `N O T I C E D`; nothing noticed either → the section is absent and the blank-line rhythm is kept; no gate yet → `gate      not run yet` in dimColor.
spacingRules: Horizontal grid (72 columns, content cols 2–71 inside paddingX=1): col 1 is the left gutter; masthead glyph and section labels sit at col 2, the masthead title and branch at col 4; every item row has its glyph at col 4 and its text at col 6; SIGNALS and step-detail labels occupy cols 4–13 (width 10) with values at col 14; the right column (sha, agent, age, count, cost, rule tails) is right-aligned flush at col 71, col 72 is the right margin; text is truncated with `…` before it can come within 2 cells of the right column. Section rule: label + one space + hairline to col 71; with a tail, hairline + two spaces + tail, the tail ending at col 71. Vertical rhythm: masthead is two lines (health, title, elapsed; then branch, meter, count) with no rule of its own; exactly one blank line before every section label and before the footer; no blank lines inside a section. Two-column inline layout (width ≥ 96): each half follows the same grid at its own width (glyph col 4, right column flush at the half's last cell, one blank line between sections, labels untracked when the half is under 48 cells). Never adjacent: two rules, or a rule and the meter; a label and the previous section's last row; two coloured runs (a coloured glyph is always followed by an ink or grey word); the footer and the last signal. Separators inside a row are ` · ` and nothing else; when the band drops its meter the count and the step are joined by one space, not two.
desktopNotes: Proportional font: hairlines are dropped (the code already draws label-only sections with marginTop 1) and the tracked-caps labels stay as plain strings in `inactive` bold, which still read as small caps. The right column holds because rows are flex rows with a flexGrow spacer, not space padding; the SIGNALS and step-detail label columns become a `Box width={10}` instead of `padEnd`. The masthead keeps the health glyph, bold title and elapsed on one row and the branch, meter and count on the next, then one blank line. Mobile is the same with the meter at 10 cells and the footer wrapping onto two rows. VS Code has no band; the pane follows the desktop rules. Hover fills exist only on terminal and desktop keyed Boxes.

animation.idea: None, by design. A set page does not fidget: nothing breathes, nothing scrolls, no cell cycles. Change is the only motion: a step going done snaps ○ to ✓, a gate pass appears as ✓ in the SIGNALS row, the meter inks one more cell, and a question raised adds its row under NEEDS YOU. Stillness is the character here; the terracotta ● already says where the work is.
animation.trigger: State change only (a step done, a gate result, a commit, a question raised or answered), through the redraws the mod already does on worklog and facts updates. No timer, no frame loop, nothing idle-aware to manage because nothing idles.
animation.staticFrame: ● in claude bold at the glyph column of the doing step (line 12 of the mock); it is the only frame.

feasibility: Everything in the mock is Box, Text and Button with theme keys (`text`, `inactive`, `subtle`, `claude`, `success`, `warning`, `error`), no borderStyle, no Raster, no Client. Points to verify: (1) the band step title needs colour inside a `plain` Button; the brief says Buttons may hold Text chips, so the label becomes a `<Text color="claude">` chip; if a chip is not honoured there, the step title falls back to bold ink and the terracotta stays on the pane only. (2) The band's gate segment becomes three Texts (dim `gate`, success `✓`, dim `4m`) instead of one toned segment. (3) `┈` (U+2508) is East-Asian-ambiguous width exactly like today's `─` and `━`, so no new risk; `§` (U+00A7) likewise. (4) The footer is drawn as the engine draws hotkey Buttons (`1: Overview`), with the active label as a bold Text chip inside the plain Button; the hotkey prefix is the engine's and is not dimmed. (5) Section rules reach col 71 only once ruleParts' slack changes (see implementationNotes); the mock's PLAN line is measured against the new formula: label 7 + 1 + line 50 + 2 + tail 10 = 70. (6) `subtle` and `inactive` are theme keys on every surface, so the three grey tiers hold on light terminals where dimColor alone would vanish.
implementationNotes:
- `rule()` / `ruleParts()`: letter-space the label (`[...label].join(' ')`, untracked when `columns < 48`), draw it `inactive` bold, use `┈` in `subtle` for the line, add `marginTop={1}` in mono too; geometry changes so the row is exactly the content width: without a tail `line = width - label - 1`; with a tail `room = width - label - 3`, `tail = clipTitle(tail, room)`, `line = width - label - shown - 3`, row = `label + ' ' + line + '  ' + tail`.
- Tones: `TONE.doing` → `claude`; `TONE.done` → undefined with dimColor; phase `▶` and the current chip → `claude`; `healthOf` returns tone `claude` for the working `▶` (band and masthead); `meter()` filled drawn bold with no colour, empty `┈` in `subtle`; the masthead stays two rows and gains no rule.
- `stepRow` / `needsBlock`: glyph at a fixed 3-cell indent, right column always dimColor and placed via flexGrow; `stepRow` shows a running agent on any step whose id it is linked to, not only doing steps (B5 `sonnet 1m`); needs rows gain a right column (`blocks B4` from the decision's `blocks`, the drift age moves from the left to the right) and the section label loses its glyph (`N E E D S  Y O U` / `N O T I C E D`).
- `signalsBlock`: three rows with a width-10 `inactive` label Box (`gate`, `git`, `context`), the value in ink, the secondary fact (`took 52s`, `6 today`, `$4.10`) right-aligned in dimColor; `stepDetail.field` uses the same width-10 label Box.
- `drawBand`: step label as a `<Text color="claude">` chip inside the plain Button; gate split into dim/success/dim Texts; empty meter cells `┈` in `subtle`; the separator between count and step moves into the `bar2` segment so that when the bar drops the count and step are one space apart.
- Footer: active tab as a bold Text chip instead of brackets; `gap={2}` kept; hover on pressable rows is a keyed Box with `subtle` background on terminal and desktop only.
- Row budget in `drawPane`: `signalRows` becomes 4 (label + 3 rows) and the four blank lines are subtracted: `stepRows = budget - needsRows - 4 - 4 - 3`. Collapse order when the pane is short: fold done steps above the doing one first (`✓ n done above`), then the blank lines before SIGNALS and PLAN, then the blank before NEEDS YOU, the footer gap last; the two-column layout never has a masthead rule and follows the same order per half.
- Plan tab (`fullPlan`): the phase row keeps its fold mark after the glyph (`▶ ▾ B UI`) and gains a hairline to the count in mono; on proportional surfaces it is the label alone with marginTop 1.
